rationale: Every record a model-written module built from its inputs is constructed by an emitted builder: the source of each target field and the disposal of each input field are this IR, checked RC001-RC015 at the State 6 handoff, instead of prose field maps in notes. Field sources are the gap list's (current behaviour accepted, owner 2026-11-06) with the owner's answers of 2026-11-08 to Q01-Q08. A value computed by behaviour (a sum, a lookup, a condition, a validation with a typed rejection, a store read, the one clock reading of the operation) is a builder parameter its caller computes. Not covered: the three Registry decoders of registry_gateway (wire decoding, outside 6.13, LLM-generated) and the router and viewer-cookie projections of api and api_irregular, which their own backends own (SPEC_STANDARD 6.1). Owner Q07 (2026-11-08): build_expense_allocation_view keeps section_display_name as a parameter (a look-up with absence is behaviour, 6.13): _project_expense_summary passes the display_name of the section's plan in the active version, or None.
